verdicts.reason: A keeps the original order of headline, then LIMITED badge, then CTA, in one grouped stack. The headline is large and readable, and the CTA is a clear button. Flaws: the headline stacks up to five lines with a 'little' / 'sunshine.' ragged rag and nearly touches the top edge. The badge is left-aligned and off-axis from the centred CTA. The bottom ~25% is empty. B throws the headline into the lower-middle at small size. It puts the CTA and badge as tiny, cramped fragments jammed against the top-left edge, which makes the CTA buried and the hierarchy and reading order inverted. It also leaves large dead areas above and below the headline.
